moments.alt: President Obama, in a dark zip jacket and white shirt, sits hunched at the corner of the Situation Room table, staring intently at a screen out of frame beside a uniformed Air Force officer.

moments.quote: Nevertheless, FBI information since that time indicates patterns of suspicious activity in this country consistent with preparations for hijackings or other types of attacks, including recent surveillance of federal buildings in New York.
moments.short: …including recent surveillance of federal buildings in New York.

moments.quote: approximately 18 minutes of the Presidential tape recording of that meeting subpoenaed by the Grand Jury, including all of the discussion of Watergate, has been obliterated.
moments.short: …including all of the discussion of Watergate, has been obliterated.

moments.alt: Truman's pencilled note on the pink back of the cable reads 'Reply to your 41011 suggestions approved Release when ready but not sooner than August 2.', initialled HST, next to a Harry S. Truman Library stamp.

moments.quote: Review of action makes many recorded contacts and torpedoes fired appear doubtful. Freak weather effects and overeager sonarman may have accounted for many reports.
moments.short: Freak weather effects and overeager sonarman may have accounted for many reports.

moments.alt: In the Oval Office, Nixon approves Haldeman's plan to have the CIA head off the FBI's Watergate investigation: "Good deal! Play it tough."
